message.content:
Yes—if you’re experiencing excessive or disruptive noise in Atlanta, you can file a complaint with the city’s authorities. Here’s how you can do it: | Step | What to Do | Where to Go / How to File | |------|------------|---------------------------| | **1. Identify the source** | Determine whether the noise is coming from a residential, commercial, or public property. | — | | **2. Check the noise ordinance** | Atlanta’s Noise Ordinance (Title 10, Chapter 5 of the Atlanta Municipal Code) sets limits on permissible sound levels and quiet hours (typically 10 p.m.–7 a.m.). | City of Atlanta Municipal Code – Title 10, Chapter 5 | | **3. Gather evidence** | Take note of the date, time, duration, and nature of the noise. If possible, record audio or video as evidence. | — | | **4. File a complaint** | • **Phone:** Call 311 (or 404‑656‑3111 if you’re outside the city).
• **Online:** Use the City of Atlanta’s “Report a Problem” portal at https://www.atlantaga.gov/311.
• **In person:** Visit the City Hall or the local police precinct. | City of Atlanta 311 portal, City Hall, or local police precinct | | **5. Follow up** | After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. You can track the status via the 311 portal or by calling 311 again. | 311 portal or phone | | **6. Enforcement** | The City of Atlanta Police Department (or the Department of Public Safety) will investigate and may issue a citation if the noise violates the ordinance. | City Police Department | ### Quick Tips - **Quiet Hours:** Most residential areas enforce quiet hours from 10 p.m. to 7 a.m. on weekdays and 11 p.m. to 8 a.m. on weekends. Commercial zones may have different hours. - **Noise Levels:** The ordinance specifies maximum decibel levels for different times of day and zones. If you’re unsure, you can ask the police officer or the 311 dispatcher for clarification. - **Repeat Offenders:** If the same source repeatedly violates the ordinance, the city may impose fines or take further action. ### Contact Information | Agency | Phone | Website | |--------|-------|---------| | City of Atlanta Police Department | 404‑656‑3111 | https://www.atlantaga.gov/police | | City of Atlanta 311 | 311 (within Atlanta) | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 | | City of Atlanta Municipal Code | — | https://www.atlantaga.gov/municipal-code | Feel free to reach out if you need help navigating the process or if you’d like more detailed information about the specific noise ordinance provisions.
